children: Litecoin remains up over 21%, at nearly $74. Reasons behind the uptick, the largest among major cryptocurrencies, are unclear. "I don't see one clear fundamental catalyst that fully explains the move," says Lacie Zhang of Bitget Wallet. "It looks more like a combination of unusually strong network activity, a technical breakout, and a short squeeze." Nearly $5 million in LTC positions have been liquidated in the past 24 hours, according to data from Coinglass--with $2.2 billion in volume traded in that timeframe, up 144%. The uptick brings the token to its highest level since January. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
